title: Administrator sign in
description: Enter your email and password, then confirm your sign in with a code from Telegram.
accessHint: Access is available to administrator accounts only.

code.title: Confirm your sign in
code.description: A one-time code was sent to Telegram. Enter the 6 digits to complete your sign in.

codeHint: The code is valid for 5 minutes. You have up to 5 attempts.
telegramMessage: A-FRAME KG: your administrator sign in code is {code}. It is valid for 5 minutes. Do not share it with anyone.

success.title: Sign in confirmed
success.description: Telegram verification is complete. You are signed in as an administrator.

skipContent: Skip to the sign in form
